verdict.rationale: CUDA Toolkit is documented as NVIDIA's official GPU development toolchain for its accelerated computing hardware, and independent community evidence confirms real-world CUDA-based workloads (Llama 405B inference) running on H200 SXM in production, plus HPC applications built on CUDA/OpenACC. missing for 10: explicit CUDA docs page naming 'H200' as a supported compute-capability target rather than general 'NVIDIA GPU' language.
